detail:
Decisions: Proposed (pending Dave's approval): the v2 backend default flip must use a legacy-detection resolution rule — sqlite for new/migrated projects, files + migrate-nudge for unmigrated legacy projects — because flipping DEFAULT_CONFIG alone would boot legacy projects against an empty database (silent amnesia).; Proposed (pending approval): recommend startup NUDGE over FOUNDATION-PLAN's auto-migration — the plan predates the standalone migrate CLI; full-auto surprise-mutates tracked config.yml and drops records/ into every teammate's diff when one person upgrades.; Proposed (pending approval): v2.0.0-beta ships under npm dist-tag next, never latest — README's install path is unpinned npx, so a latest-tagged v2 flips every direct user instantly; the plugin's caret pin already firewalls plugin users until a deliberate 1.11 bump.
Findings: Rollout levers mapped: unpinned npx install base follows the latest dist-tag instantly; plugin ^1.20.0 caret excludes 2.x so plugin users upgrade only via a plugin release. Publish workflow needs a prerelease/dist-tag change (V1) before any beta.
summary: v2.0 prep PROPOSED (not shipped): plan doc written — default flip w/ legacy-detection rule, engines 22.13, config v2, beta on dist-tag next, plugin pin bump last. Awaiting go-ahead.
